subject: RAISE statement
notes: "If identifier-1 is specified, EXCEPTION-OBJECT is set to reference the object referenced by identifier-1. If there is no applicable declarative, processing continues with the statement following the RAISE statement." (cite.py --check 14.9.29.4 -> OK §14.9.29.4 2)). EmitRaiseObject calls ExceptionState.SetObject(obj) then dispatches F4 declaratives, continuing after the RAISE on complete / RESUME NEXT / no match. Probes: probe/raise/gr2.cob (no declaratives) prints 'A0 EXCEPTION-OBJECT' then continues, including a RAISE of a reference holding NULL at runtime ('A1'); probe/raise/sr2b.cob (USE AFTER EO CERR2) runs the handler and continues after each of RAISE E / RAISE U / RAISE EXCEPTION-OBJECT; conformance:cases/14.6.13.1.5-Exception-objects/oo_ec_raise_object shows the handler reading the same object back (REGISTER-SET). Both halves verified; edition 2002 probed identically.
